# Acceptance Criteria & Security Checklist: FinSync Core System

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness, measurability, acceptance scenarios, and JWT security compliance before and during implementation.
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Success Criteria Measurability & Precision

- [ ] CHK001 Is the maximum allowable duration for manual transaction and photo entry quantified with an objective threshold? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the minimum percentage reduction in group settlement transfers mathematically defined and verifiable for groups of 5 or more members? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the delivery time windows for 80% and 100% budget warning notifications quantified with unambiguous thresholds? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the acceptance threshold for AI spending anomaly relevance defined with a measurable user feedback percentage? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the response latency for administrative session invalidation upon account lock quantified with an objective time limit? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the non-custodial zero-custody constraint defined with verifiable zero-retention criteria for banking credentials and automated deductions? [Consistency, Spec §SC-006, Constitution §I]

---

## 2. Personal Bookkeeping & Multi-Wallet Requirements (User Story 1)

- [ ] CHK007 Are immediate wallet balance deduction and receipt attachment visibility requirements explicitly specified for personal expenses? [Completeness, Spec §US-1.1]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the triggering conditions and notification behaviors for 80% category budget threshold utilization clearly defined? [Clarity, Spec §US-1.2]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the system rejection and error prompt behavior unambiguous when a user attempts to create a duplicate wallet name? [Clarity, Spec §US-1.3]
- [ ] CHK010 Are immediate recalculation requirements specified for both wallet balances and category budget totals when transactions are updated or deleted? [Completeness, Spec §US-1.4]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the distinct requirements between permanent deletion (zero transactions) and archival soft-delete (with transactions) clearly defined? [Coverage, Spec §US-1.5, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK012 Are privacy and parsing requirements explicitly defined for user-initiated SMS/notification paste without silent background listeners? [Completeness, Spec §US-1.6, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK013 Are Credit Card wallet balance semantics (tracking outstanding debt) and Net Worth formula subtraction clearly specified? [Clarity, Spec §US-1.7, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK014 Are inter-wallet transfer requirements specified for repaying Credit Card debt from a Bank wallet? [Completeness, Spec §US-1.8]

---

## 3. Group Expense & Smart Debt Settlement Requirements (User Story 2)

- [ ] CHK015 Are equal splitting arithmetic and individual debt assignment rules clearly specified for group expenses? [Clarity, Spec §US-2.1, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK016 Are graph simplification requirements specified to eliminate redundant intermediary transfers among members? [Completeness, Spec §US-2.2, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the manual settlement confirmation requirement by the payee member explicitly mandated before debt balances clear? [Consistency, Spec §US-2.3, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the override authority, evidence review, and audit justification logging requirements defined for Ledger Owners in disputed settlements? [Completeness, Spec §US-2.4, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the deletion guardrail blocking removal of members with non-zero outstanding net balances unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §US-2.5, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the maximum member capacity limit (50 members) and rejection behavior explicitly documented for shared ledgers? [Completeness, Spec §US-2.6, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the Single Payer model and support for Equal, Exact, and Percentage split methods explicitly mandated for every group expense? [Clarity, Spec §US-2.7, Spec §FR-007]

---

## 4. Financial Analytics & AI Advisory Requirements (User Story 3)

- [ ] CHK022 Is the spending anomaly threshold quantified as a greater than 40% deviation from a 3-month rolling average? [Measurability, Spec §US-3.1, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK023 Are proactive budget reallocation recommendations specified to align with user-defined savings goal deadlines and targets? [Completeness, Spec §US-3.2, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK024 Does the specification strictly prohibit collecting or exposing private banking credentials in AI prompts and advisory outputs? [Security, Spec §US-3.3, Constitution §IV]

---

## 5. Platform Administration & Governance Requirements (User Story 4)

- [ ] CHK025 Are administrative account lock requirements defined to immediately terminate active user sessions and reject subsequent logins? [Completeness, Spec §US-4.1, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK026 Are propagation requirements specified for global category taxonomy updates to apply to all newly created user accounts? [Clarity, Spec §US-4.2, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK027 Are telemetry metrics defined to aggregate platform usage without leaking individual transaction notes or private balances? [Security, Spec §US-4.3, Spec §FR-015]

---

## 6. FinSync Security & API JWT Architecture

- [ ] CHK028 Are stateless JWT authentication requirements specified for all protected REST API endpoints? [Security, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK029 Are token expiration periods and renewal/re-authentication policies explicitly defined? [Security, Constitution §III, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK030 Is immediate token invalidation/revocation behavior specified across distributed sessions when an account status changes to `LOCKED`? [Security, Spec §SC-005, Plan §Data Model]
- [ ] CHK031 Are role-based access control (RBAC) boundaries between `ROLE_USER` and `ROLE_ADMIN` endpoints unambiguous? [Security, Plan §Contracts]
- [ ] CHK032 Are environment-based secret key management and zero-committed credentials policies documented for JWT secrets? [Security, Constitution §Security Requirements]
- [ ] CHK033 Are CORS policies and secure header requirements defined to prevent unauthorized cross-origin API invocations? [Security, Plan §Phase 7]

---

## 7. Edge Cases & Data Integrity Coverage

- [ ] CHK034 Is the deterministic remainder cent allocation rule specified to ensure zero lost cents in split arithmetic? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK035 Are offline queuing, sequence preservation, and de-duplication requirements defined for intermittent mobile connectivity? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK036 Are optimistic locking and concurrency control requirements specified for simultaneous ledger expense submissions? [Edge Cases, Plan §Research, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK037 Are fallback requirements defined when pasted text cannot be parsed by regex or LLM into a structured transaction draft? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001 - CHK037) for easy reference and auditability.
